plan.scope: I10 actual known-schedule default: freeze one sampled granted opportunity only after the whole command batch is applied; retain other accepted and queued owned tones and known releases in baseline and alternatives. Allow multiple On/Off commands while keeping one bounded preview per source. Preserve ordinary audio and observed learning.
contract: The focused recipe is the first eligible granted recipe already identified by the existing sampled record. Other accepted/queued tones remain in the known baseline; no future policy calls or random draws.
The recorded first accepted default transition and full known inventory are distinct from the focused opportunity input. Composite/queued defaults cannot use a single-class shared prototype baseline.
Gap suppresses already queued excitations whose onset falls in its half-open withholding interval, retaining tails of tones active at the gap time. Existing untargeted releases are retained.
Known pending control changes are not silently treated as a stable amplitude/control forecast. Unsupported projections remain unknown, never assumed zero.
This closes compound/queued known-schedule input, not unreserved future recipe generation, all subsequent policy commands, prototype transfer validity, non-energy heads or I10 completion.
validation: Focused numerical tests for queued tones, gap endpoints, baseline/difference and unknown controls.
Ordinary renderer tests for multi-On, Off+On, routing, body generation, queue boundaries and post-batch snapshots, with observer-off exact audio and no hypothetical outcome learning.
Full Rust tests with logs, clippy/alltargets/fmt; release runtime fixtures and independent comparison of old/new records with added scopes retained.

limits: One existing20Hz sampled focused granted recipe per source and batch, after every command/update in that batch; at most64 total tones and64 pooled requests. Previously accepted/queued owned tones keep their routing and known releases. No additional future policy evaluation or random draw.

The first accepted default transition is distinct from the focused opportunity input. Shared single-class prototype comparisons reject composite/queued/unsupported-control defaults as composite_default. Full compound prototype conditioning and physical transfer validation remain incomplete.

Gap withholds queued onsets on the half-open interval[action_at,withhold_until); active release tails and onsets at the upper endpoint remain. Release alone does not cancel a future onset. Window reuse is bypassed when a queued onset is withheld.

Pending ToneUpdate commands or unfinished amplitude smoothing make the candidate control forecast unknown. They are not analytically forecast. Envelope-zero portions remain known zero, including canceled onsets. Actual audio and learned observation paths are unchanged.

Body generation may remain null in the pre-existing diagnostic-only path without Capture; matching optional tokens and source generation are required. Active-body sampling still requires Capture and at least one currently active tone; an exclusively queued idle body is not newly sampled.

Only the first eligible granted recipe from the sampled batch is focused. If that recipe is rejected, this unit does not select a later recipe. Later batches for the same source in the same hop are outside this snapshot. Off-only batches and unreserved future opportunities are not completed by this change.

Numerical fixtures cover half-open gap endpoints, release tails, queued routing, unknown controls, cache differences and active/onset default energies. Renderer comparisons cover multi-On, Off/On order, post-On cancellation, future updates, source/body-generation rejection and capacity, alongside existing actual-only learning comparison.

The six ordinary hold/flow4/16/64 cases validate both-bus audio, actual observed learning and diagnostic isolation. Short-run wall profiles are not CPU or whole-load acceptance. The prior failed40ms/8.5333ms screens remain unresolved.

Full future policy default, non-energy consequences, remaining shared/joint integrations, prototype transfer accuracy, full-duration/all-eight-prototype preflight and live acceptance remain incomplete. I10 active; I9 held; I11 disabled; default evaluation timing unchanged.
